title: Contact form & emails
description: Everything a client reads while sending a request, and the emails they get back. Leave a field empty to use the original wording. Words in {curly brackets} are filled in automatically, so keep them as they are.

chooseIntro.title: Line under that heading
chooseIntro.default: Pick one, then tell me a little about it.

chooseAria.title: Name of the three choices, read aloud
chooseAria.description: Not shown on screen. A screen reader says this before reading the three choices.

cardTailoringBlurb.title: Tailoring choice: description
cardTailoringBlurb.default: Hems, waists, sleeves, zips. Open now, usually done within two weeks.

cardBridalTitle.title: Bridal choice: title
cardBridalTitle.description: Used while bridal is open for bookings.

cardBridalBlurb.title: Bridal choice: description
cardBridalBlurb.description: Used while bridal is open for bookings.
cardBridalBlurb.default: Hems, bustles, bodice work and fittings for your gown.

cardBridalWaitlistTitle.title: Bridal choice: title while on the waitlist
cardBridalWaitlistTitle.description: Used while Site Settings has limited availability turned on. {reopens} becomes the reopening time from Site Settings, such as "early 2027".

cardBridalWaitlistBlurb.title: Bridal choice: description while on the waitlist
cardBridalWaitlistBlurb.default: Join the waitlist and you'll get first pick of fitting dates, in the order you joined.

cardPartyBlurb.title: Bridal party choice: description
cardPartyBlurb.default: Bridesmaids, mothers, flower girls: one point of contact, one pickup day.

formHeading.title: Form heading
formHeading.description: Shown above the form once a choice is picked.

formHeadingWaitlist.title: Form heading while you're not taking new clients
formHeadingWaitlist.description: Used when "accepting clients" is turned off in Site Settings.

formHeadingBridalWaitlist.title: Form heading for bridal while it's on the waitlist

formAria.title: Name of the form, read aloud
formAria.description: Not shown on screen. A screen reader says this when it reaches the form.

namePlaceholder.title: Name: grey hint inside the box

emailPlaceholder.title: Email: grey hint inside the box

optional.title: "Optional" tag
optional.description: Shown after the label of a field a client can leave empty, such as Venue or Photos.

weddingDateLabel.title: Bridal: wedding date label
weddingDateLabel.description: The note that appears under it is in "Guides & tools", under Wedding date messages.

designerLabel.title: Bridal: dress designer label
designerLabel.default: Dress designer, or where you bought it

alterationsLabel.title: Bridal: heading over the tick boxes

optHem.title: Bridal tick box: hem
optHem.description: The tick box names are also used by the photo check's suggestions and in the request email you receive.

optStraps.title: Bridal tick box: straps or sleeves

optLaceBeading.title: Bridal tick box: lace or beading

shoesLabel.title: Bridal: shoes and undergarments question
shoesLabel.default: Do you have your shoes and undergarments yet?

selectOne.title: "Select one" in drop-down lists
selectOne.description: What a drop-down list says before anything is picked.

garmentCountLabel.title: Bridal party: number of garments label

garmentCountPlaceholder.title: Bridal party: number of garments hint

notesLabelTailoring.title: Tailoring: notes label
notesLabelTailoring.default: The garment, and what you'd like done

notesPlaceholderTailoring.title: Tailoring: notes hint
notesPlaceholderTailoring.default: e.g. navy trousers, hem to flat shoes

notesPlaceholderBridal.title: Bridal: notes hint
notesPlaceholderBridal.default: e.g. fabric, lace or beading, anything you are worried about

notesPlaceholder.title: Bridal party: notes hint
notesPlaceholder.default: Anything you want me to know

referralOptions.title: "How did you find me?" answers
referralOptions.description: One answer per line. The one a client picks appears in your request email.
referralOptions.default:
Google
Instagram
Bridal shop
Wedding planner
The Knot / WeddingWire
A friend who was a client
Other

photosLabel.title: Photos: label
photosLabel.description: Followed by the "Optional" tag from Form fields.

photosHint.title: Photos: note under the label
photosHint.description: {max} becomes the most photos a client can add (5).
photosHint.default: Up to {max} photos. Front, back, and a close-up of anything you are worried about. Large photos are resized before sending.

photosPreparing.title: Add photos box while photos are being prepared

photoRemove.title: Remove photo button, read aloud
photoRemove.description: Not shown on screen: the button is a small ×. A screen reader says this. {file} becomes the photo's file name.

photoTooBigTogether.title: Photos too large to send together
photoTooBigTogether.description: {file} becomes the photo's file name; {email} becomes your email address from Site Settings.
photoTooBigTogether.default: "{file}" would make the photos too large to send together. Try fewer photos, or email the rest to {email}.

photoUnreadable.title: Photo could not be read
photoUnreadable.default: One of those photos could not be read. Please try another.

pcButton.title: Check button
pcButton.description: Appears under the photos once a client adds one.

pcButtonAgain.title: Check button after the photos change

pcIntro.title: Note beside the check button
pcIntro.description: The sentence saying where the photos go is fixed and follows this, so the disclosure always stays accurate.
pcIntro.default: Optional. A quick automated read of what the photos show (the garment, the likely fabric, visible details) to help you describe it. It never quotes or recommends work; Grace does that in person.

pcCheckingSome.title: While checking two or three photos

pcCheckingMany.title: While checking more than three photos
pcCheckingMany.description: Only the first three are checked.
pcCheckingMany.default: Looking at the first three photos…

pcUnavailable.title: Check isn't working
pcUnavailable.default: The check isn't available right now. Your request will still send.

pcUnreadable.title: Photos too unclear to read
pcUnreadable.default: The check couldn’t read these photos.

pcUnreadableTip.title: Tip after unclear photos
pcUnreadableTip.default: A full-length photo of the garment in good light works best. Or just send them; Grace will look herself.

pcSureHigh.title: How sure: very
pcSureHigh.description: Shown beside the garment and each fabric.

pcSuggest.title: Line above the suggested tick boxes
pcSuggest.description: Bridal only. The suggestions use the tick box names from Form fields.
pcSuggest.default: Related to what’s visible. Tap any that match what you want:

pcCannotShow.title: "Photos can't show" lead-in
pcCannotShow.description: Followed by a short list of things photos can't tell.

pcIncludeHint.title: Send it along: note
pcIncludeHint.default: Anything wrong? Untick it, or say so in your notes. It’s a starting point, not a quote.

submitWaitlist.title: Send button when joining the waitlist

submitAskDate.title: Send button when the wedding date is tight
submitAskDate.description: Used when the wedding is under eight weeks away, or the first fitting falls before bridal reopens.

errorPrefix.title: Word before every error
errorPrefix.description: Comes before each message below, as in "Error: Please add your name."

errEmailMissing.title: Email left empty
errEmailMissing.default: Please add an email address so I can reply.

errEmailInvalid.title: Email doesn't look right
errEmailInvalid.default: That email address does not look right.

sendFailed.title: Request didn't send
sendFailed.description: Follows "Error:", so it starts in lower case.

sendTooLarge.title: Request didn't send: photos too large
sendTooLarge.default: The photos were too large to send.

sendTooMany.title: Request didn't send: too many tries
sendTooMany.default: Too many requests from this connection.

sendEmailMe.title: After a failed send: email me instead
sendEmailMe.description: {email} becomes your email address from Site Settings, as a link.

policiesLine.title: Policies line under the button
policiesLine.description: Shown once you have policies. {policies} becomes a link to your policies page, using the words below.
policiesLine.default: By sending this you agree to my {policies}.

contactHeroAria.title: Top of the page, read aloud
contactHeroAria.description: Not shown on screen. A screen reader's name for the dark banner at the top.

contactSectionAria.title: Form and details section, read aloud
contactSectionAria.description: Not shown on screen. A screen reader's name for the part of the page with the form.

infoLocationLine.title: Location line
infoLocationLine.description: {location} becomes the location from Site Settings.

faqLabel.title: Questions: small label
faqLabel.description: Above the questions at the bottom of the contact page.

confirmSubject.title: Request received: subject line
confirmSubject.default: Your request was received · Grace Mae Alterations

confirmGreeting.title: Greeting
confirmGreeting.description: Starts every confirmation email. {name} becomes the client's first name.

confirmGreetingNoName.title: Greeting without a name
confirmGreetingNoName.description: Used when the name typed in isn't a plain first name.

confirmIntro.title: Request received: first paragraph
confirmIntro.description: Follows the greeting ("Hi Ann,"), so it starts in lower case.
confirmIntro.default: thank you for reaching out. I've received your request, and I read every message myself. I'll reply as soon as I can.

confirmNextSteps.title: "What happens next" steps
confirmNextSteps.description: One step per line; they are numbered in the email.
confirmNextSteps.default:
I'll review your request and reach out to schedule your first fitting.
At the fitting we'll look at the garment together, talk through the alterations, and I'll give you a quote and a realistic timeline.
Alterations begin after the fitting and a deposit. I'll keep you updated along the way.

confirmBringHeading.title: "What to bring" heading
confirmBringHeading.default: What to Bring to Your First Fitting

confirmBringBridal.title: What to bring: bridal
confirmBringBridal.default:
Your wedding dress
The shoes you plan to wear on your wedding day, since heel height sets the hem length
Any undergarments, shapewear, or a strapless bra you plan to wear with the gown
Any accessories you'd like to try on with the dress

confirmBringTailoring.title: What to bring: tailoring or repair
confirmBringTailoring.default:
The garment(s) you need altered
Shoes you plan to wear, if a hem adjustment is involved

confirmBringParty.title: What to bring: bridal party
confirmBringParty.default:
Each garment, labelled with who will wear it
The shoes each person plans to wear, if hems are involved
Anyone being fitted, or a date when they can come in

confirmBringOther.title: What to bring: no type picked
confirmBringOther.default:
The garment(s) you need altered
Shoes if a hem adjustment is involved

confirmQuestions.title: Request received: questions line
confirmQuestions.description: {email} becomes your email address, as a link.
confirmQuestions.default: Questions in the meantime? Reply to this email or reach me at {email}.

confirmWaitlistSubject.title: Waitlist: subject line
confirmWaitlistSubject.default: You're on my waitlist · Grace Mae Alterations

confirmWaitlistIntroBridal.title: Waitlist: first paragraph (bridal)
confirmWaitlistIntroBridal.description: Follows the greeting, so it starts in lower case. {reopens} becomes the reopening time from Site Settings.
confirmWaitlistIntroBridal.default: you're on my bridal waitlist. I'll reach out in order as dates open for {reopens}.

confirmWaitlistIntroReopens.title: Waitlist: first paragraph (other requests, with a reopening time)
confirmWaitlistIntroReopens.description: Follows the greeting, so it starts in lower case. {reopens} becomes the reopening time from Site Settings.
confirmWaitlistIntroReopens.default: you're on my waitlist. I'll reach out in order as dates open for {reopens}.

confirmWaitlistIntro.title: Waitlist: first paragraph (no reopening time set)
confirmWaitlistIntro.description: Follows the greeting, so it starts in lower case.
confirmWaitlistIntro.default: your request has been received and you're on my waitlist. I'll reach out as soon as a spot opens up.

confirmWaitlistMeantime.title: Waitlist: second paragraph
confirmWaitlistMeantime.description: Also used in the "I have your date" email.
confirmWaitlistMeantime.default: In the meantime, feel free to reply to this email with any questions.

confirmDateSubject.title: "I have your date": subject line
confirmDateSubject.description: Sent instead of the waitlist email when a bride's date is under eight weeks away, or her first fitting falls before bridal reopens.
confirmDateSubject.default: About your date · Grace Mae Alterations

confirmDateIntro.title: "I have your date": first paragraph
confirmDateIntro.default: I have your request and your date. I'll tell you honestly whether I can fit it in, and if I can't, I'll suggest someone who can.

confirmSignLine.title: Sign-off line
confirmSignLine.description: Under your name at the end of every email.
confirmSignLine.default: Grace Mae Alterations · Pittsburgh, PA · By appointment only

careLabel.title: Care page: small label
careLabel.description: Used when the card has no first name.

careLabelNamed.title: Care page: small label with a name
careLabelNamed.description: {name} becomes the client's first name from the care card.

careHeading.title: Care page: heading
careHeading.description: {garment} becomes the garment from the care card, such as "wedding gown".

careThanks.title: Care page: thank-you line
careThanks.default: Thank you for trusting me with it.

careAlteredOn.title: Care page: altered line with the date
careAlteredOn.description: {date} becomes the month it was finished, such as "May 2026".

careFabric.title: Care page: fabric line
careFabric.description: Shown when the card has a fabric. {fabric} becomes the fabric, in lower case.

carePhotoAria.title: Care page: photos, read aloud
carePhotoAria.description: Not shown on screen. A screen reader's name for the before and after photos.

carePhotoAlt.title: Care page: photo description
carePhotoAlt.description: Read aloud when a photo has no description of its own. {garment} becomes the garment.

careNotesAria.title: Care page: care notes, read aloud
careNotesAria.description: Not shown on screen. A screen reader's name for the care notes section.

careReviewHeading.title: Care page: reviews heading
careReviewHeading.default: If you loved how it turned out

careReviewText.title: Care page: reviews line
careReviewText.default: A few words from you help the next bride find me more than anything I could say myself.

careReviewButton.title: Care page: Google review button
careReviewButton.description: Shown once a review link is set in Site Settings.

careInstagramButton.title: Care page: Instagram button
careInstagramButton.description: {instagram} becomes your Instagram handle from Site Settings.

careMore.title: Care page: closing line
careMore.description: {link} becomes a link to the contact page, using the words below.
careMore.default: Something not sitting right, or another piece that needs work? {link}.

careCardSubtitle.title: Printed card: line under your name

careCardHeading.title: Printed card: heading
careCardHeading.description: {garment} becomes the garment from the care card.

careCardScan.title: Printed card: scan line
careCardScan.default: Scan for how to store and clean it, and your before and after.

careCardPrintTabTitle.title: Print page: browser tab title
careCardPrintTabTitle.description: The print page is only for you.

careCardPrintHeading.title: Print page: heading
careCardPrintHeading.description: Only for you. {garment} becomes the garment from the care card.

careCardPrintNote.title: Print page: printing note
careCardPrintNote.default: Prints at business-card size on its own. Heavy cardstock works best. Trim along the dashed line and tuck it in the garment bag.

careCardPrintOpen.title: Print page: link to the care page
